title: stop scrolling, you prayed for this

segments.text: God is listening to you. God knows your heart. God knows your pain
He knows every hardship you've gone through and every hardship that you will go through
A lot of us confuse these trials and tribulations that we're put through as problems with our own personal lives
But it's simply not true. A lot of times we look at it as problems, as issues, when in actual fact
These are tests that God put us through to get us to be better, to make us grow stronger
Just like how when we go to the gym, our muscles have to be put to failure in order to grow bigger, stronger
and that comes with strength training and rest
And just like how when we squeeze an olive oil comes out, when we squeeze grapes, wine comes out and how diamonds are formed under pressure
When we are put under pressure, that's how we get strong and only in these times of
Suffering and pain can we see growth in our own life. If there were no hardships, there will be no enjoyment of the easy times
That is why they say hard times make tough men
And I think a lot of often times we forget
And we want the reward, we want the reward so quickly and we forget that
After all of this, our breakthrough is right around the corner. We want benefits in our health
We want breakthroughs in our success, in our relationships with our family, with our
Academics, with our career
Oftentimes our breakthroughs are right around the corner
But because we're so fixated on I want things to get it done right now. I want them to get it done right now
We just lose track of all the things that we want and we refuse, we push back God's will and say God
I want you to follow me. But in actual fact, he just said oh wait a day, wait a week and
Everything you have ever wanted will come into fruition. You just had to wait. You just had to have faith
That's why we call it faith, a leap of faith
I really think it's such a sad moment because God has so much things for us
And he just wants us to have the strength to trust in him
The strength to endure every hardship he's put in front of us
So my prayer for you today is not to ask for calm seas, not to ask for the easy life
But instead to ask for the strength to endure the hard ones
So that no weapon that comes against us will ever prosper and every stronghold that is holding us must break
That's what we want, we want the strength, we don't want easy life
There's nothing that comes out of an easy life. We just get lazy
We just get depressed and we just doomscrew all the time. When in actual fact we want a hard meaningful fruitful life
That's why they call it the fruits of the spirit where we have love, joy and peace
Only when we go through these hardships, when we put on the full armor of God
Can we see these fruits come to life? That's why they call it sowing and harvesting the fruits
Honestly, we have to be open to suffering
And that's my prayer and that's why we have all been praying for these things
Oh God, I've been going through these breakthroughs
I've been going through these problems and I need these breakthroughs
But just like how John, he was in the pot of oil and he took no pain
He had no injuries at all. It is the whole point. It is through these problems
God gives you the strength to say no
None of these problems will ever affect you and you will only come out stronger
Everyone saw him and that was the glory of God. They saw in suffering
They saw that John displayed the glory of God. They rejoice because you're in the middle of what you've been praying for
So have a little faith
Have a little faith in the Lord
